title: Pingdin — Tenant Capacity & Usage (counts only, Managed tenants)

panels.title: Latest measurement per tenant
panels.description: The newest row of core.tenant_usage for each tenant. Quotas and tiers are set and shown at /ops/tenants/<slug>/capacity (the read-only Grafana role cannot see tenant config).

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.slug) t.slug AS tenant, round(u.storage_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) AS storage_mb, u.storage_objects AS files, u.edge_rows AS rows_held, u.messages_24h AS messages_24h, u.failed_24h AS failed_24h, u.dead_24h AS gave_up_24h, u.llm_requests AS ai_requests_today, u.llm_tokens AS ai_tokens_today, u.measured_at AS measured_at FROM core.tenant_usage u JOIN core.tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE ('$tenant' = '' OR t.slug = '$tenant') ORDER BY t.slug, u.day DESC

panels.title: Storage used (MB)
panels.description: Spaces bytes under each tenant's own prefix, from Edge's sweep (every few hours; the day's last measurement).

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.day::timestamptz AS time, t.slug AS metric, round(u.storage_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) AS "storage_mb" FROM core.tenant_usage u JOIN core.tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date AND ('$tenant' = '' OR t.slug = '$tenant') ORDER BY u.day

panels.title: Rows held
panels.description: Rows the tenant holds across Edge's tenant tables (short-lived working tables excluded).

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.day::timestamptz AS time, t.slug AS metric, u.edge_rows AS "edge_rows" FROM core.tenant_usage u JOIN core.tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date AND ('$tenant' = '' OR t.slug = '$tenant') ORDER BY u.day

panels.title: Messages in the last 24 h
panels.description: Inbound messages Edge handled, per tenant, at the time of each measurement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.day::timestamptz AS time, t.slug AS metric, u.messages_24h AS "messages_24h" FROM core.tenant_usage u JOIN core.tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date AND ('$tenant' = '' OR t.slug = '$tenant') ORDER BY u.day

panels.title: Failed and gave-up messages (24 h)
panels.description: failed_24h includes messages Pingdin gave up on after every retry (dead_24h). Anything above zero deserves a look at /ops/tenants/<slug>/messages.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.day::timestamptz AS time, t.slug AS metric, u.failed_24h AS "failed_24h" FROM core.tenant_usage u JOIN core.tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date AND ('$tenant' = '' OR t.slug = '$tenant') ORDER BY u.day

panels.title: AI requests per day
panels.description: All AI calls for the tenant (core.usage_log), as of the day's last measurement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.day::timestamptz AS time, t.slug AS metric, u.llm_requests AS "llm_requests" FROM core.tenant_usage u JOIN core.tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date AND ('$tenant' = '' OR t.slug = '$tenant') ORDER BY u.day

panels.title: AI tokens per day
panels.description: Prompt plus completion tokens, as of the day's last measurement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.day::timestamptz AS time, t.slug AS metric, u.llm_tokens AS "llm_tokens" FROM core.tenant_usage u JOIN core.tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date AND ('$tenant' = '' OR t.slug = '$tenant') ORDER BY u.day
